versions.changelog: 优化 ClawHub 改版后的搜索可发现性：新增 Data & APIs 分类、description 中文关键词前置、display name 支持双语

- Added environment variable requirements to the skill metadata (`env` and `primaryEnv` for `CAIYUN_WEATHER_API_TOKEN`)
- Now explicitly documents in metadata that the CAIYUN_WEATHER_API_TOKEN environment variable must be set for the skill to work

- Initial release of caiyun-weather skill.
- Query real-time, hourly, weekly, historical weather, and weather alerts via Caiyun Weather API.
- Supports both Chinese and English city names; no coordinates required for popular cities.
- Requires setting the CAIYUN_WEATHER_API_TOKEN environment variable.
- Usage examples and command-line syntax provided for common scenarios.
- No external Python libraries needed; uses only Python standard library.
